prompt:
Original modern Japanese pop-rock anthem, heroic and urgent, about 60 seconds, 148 BPM, minor key that lifts to major in the chorus. Sung in Japanese by one male tenor: close, restless and low in the verse, then a huge soaring chorus with bright high notes and doubled harmonies. Instruments: an angular syncopated piano riff, tight funky electric bass, crisp live drums, sharp clean electric guitar, a sweeping string section in the chorus. Structure: 2 bar piano riff intro, verse, a rising pre-chorus with a drum fill and one beat of silence, then a full band chorus that hits hard on the first beat. End on the final chorus chord.

Lyrics, sung exactly as written:
[Verse]
灰の町で 息をひそめて
消えない火を 胸に隠した

[Pre-Chorus]
風が変わる 夜が割れる
ひとりでいい 手を伸ばせ

[Chorus]
のろしを上げろ 空の果てまで
届くまで 僕は叫ぶ
のろしを上げろ 誰かの夜に
この火を 繋いでいけ
